title: Junk Removal Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential Junk Removal: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: Junk Removal Estimate Worksheet covers removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream. The removal service coordinator records Residential Junk Removal observed scope, costs, options, and terms. Junk Removal Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential Junk Removal exceptions visible until the removal service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Junk Removal Estimate Worksheet at residence, removal zone, carry path, loading point, and approved destination. Document removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream identity before Residential Junk Removal begins. Compare removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream findings with stated Residential Junk Removal criteria; route unresolved Residential Junk Removal issues to waste-routing operations reviewer. For Junk Removal Estimate Worksheet, confirm requirements for Residential Junk Removal. Ask waste-routing operations reviewer to review Residential Junk Removal conditions beyond the removal service coordinator's role.

blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Junk Removal when material identity, safe handling, access, property protection, or lawful destination remains unresolved. Retain the available Residential Junk Removal proof and route unresolved removal item, load category, access path, protected property, and destination stream scope to removal service coordinator.
